chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
Indeed, you cannot encompass people with your wealth, so encompass them with your character.

key_terms.النَّاسَ: people in general, the wider community
key_terms.بِأَخْلَاقِكُمْ: by means of your character and moral conduct
key_terms.بِأَمْوَالِكُمْ: by means of your wealth and material resources
key_terms.تَسَعُوا: to be sufficient for, contain, or reach broadly

ai.seo_question: How does the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله teach believers to deal with people when wealth is not enough?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that wealth alone is not enough to win over or benefit all people. Instead, noble character, good conduct, and kind dealings are the universal means by which one reaches people and fulfills social obligations.
